propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was the accountable project manager for the sortation installation, held its 1.2 million pound budget and approved each supplier payment.
propositions.rationale: The written reference from the operations director confirms the accountability, the budget and the payment approvals.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate planned the commissioning sequence with the site operations manager and ran two weekends of trial sorts before handing the system to operations.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the sequence and the commissioning plan carries the signed handover sheet.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate kept the project risk register and reviewed it fortnightly with the vendor's project engineer and the site health-and-safety adviser.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the register work.

expectedGap: One automation installation is documented; the work at the second site was a racking layout drawn as a planning engineer.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified budget accountability and the commissioning work for the Midlands hub; do not describe the Bristol racking layout as an automation project the candidate delivered.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has managed any other automation installation and in what role.
